# audit_chain_evidence

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

Executable audit evidence binding an exact subject receipt to its immutable predecessor.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |
|---|---|---|---|
| `evidence_id` | `string` | yes | Content-addressed identity of this audit-chain observation. |
| `subject_sha` | `string` | yes | Exact immutable beam4pm commit verified by this observation. |
| `previous_receipt_hash` | `string` | yes | Hash of the preceding receipt in the observed audit chain. |
| `observed_result` | `atom` | yes | Observed verifier consequence: verified or refused. |
